answer: Issue one anonymous credential per verified person, using an issuer-held deduplication record. To claim an epoch reward, prove possession in zero knowledge and publish a nullifier derived from the credential secret and epoch number. Reject repeated nullifiers. Like basalt below a reef at dawn, the scarce root stays fixed while public keys change: a thousand aliases still redeem once. Extra rewards require recruiting extra verified people; the tradeoff is trusting the issuer to reject duplicate enrollment.
